definition: To put a decision, plan, or agreement into effect.
example: The government decided to implement new policies to improve public health.

definition: A result or effect of an action or condition.
example: Failing to study for the exam had serious consequences for his grades.

definition: An act of showing how something works or how to do something.
example: The teacher gave a clear demonstration of the science experiment.

definition: To inspect someone or something in detail to determine their nature or condition.
example: The doctor will examine the patient's symptoms carefully.

definition: At a previous or earlier time; before now.
example: She had previously visited that museum, so she knew her way around.

definition: To have as a plan or purpose; to mean to do something.
example: I intend to finish my homework before dinner tonight.

definition: Impossible to forget; very memorable.
example: Our trip to the mountains was an unforgettable experience.

definition: To depend on someone or something with full trust or confidence.
example: You can always rely on your friends for support.

definition: Causing a feeling of self-consciousness, shame, or awkwardness.
example: It was embarrassing when I tripped in front of everyone.

definition: What is put in, taken in, or operated on by any process or system.
example: We need more input from the team members to make the project a success.

definition: Preventing success or development; harmful or unfavorable.
example: The company faced adverse conditions due to the economic downturn.

definition: In spite of that; nevertheless.
example: It was raining heavily; nonetheless, we decided to go for a walk.

definition: To promise to do something, especially to remain loyal to a person, cause, or policy.
example: The company is committed to providing excellent customer service.

definition: The action or process of making something simpler or easier to understand.
example: The simplification of the instructions made the task much clearer.

definition: The nature of something's ingredients or constituents; the way in which a whole or mixture is made up.
example: The chemical composition of the new material is still being studied.

definition: The particular condition that someone or something is in at a specific time.
example: The building was in a poor state after years of neglect.

definition: A verbal or written remark expressing an opinion or reaction.
example: She made a useful comment during the team meeting.

definition: A disrespectful or offensive remark or action.
example: His rude comment was a direct insult to her intelligence.

definition: To cease to support or look after someone; to desert. Or to give up completely (a practice or course of action).
example: The scientists had to abandon the experiment due to technical difficulties.

definition: To walk or move in a leisurely, casual, or aimless way.
example: We decided to wander through the park without a specific destination.

definition: A person who comes to live permanently in a foreign country.
example: Many immigrants contribute greatly to the culture and economy of their new home.

definition: An object made by a human being, typically an item of cultural or historical interest.
example: Ancient artefacts were discovered during the archaeological dig.

definition: Belonging to or occurring in the present; modern.
example: Contemporary art often challenges traditional ideas and forms.

definition: Relating to the running of a home or to family relations, or of one's own country.
example: The president focused on domestic issues before addressing international affairs.

definition: To succeed in dealing with a problem or difficulty.
example: She worked hard to overcome her fear of public speaking.

definition: A person, object, or place selected as the aim of an attack, or an objective to be achieved.
example: The company set a target of increasing sales by 10% this quarter.

definition: A person who has been forced to leave their country in order to escape war, persecution, or natural disaster.
example: Many refugees seek safety and a new home in neighboring countries.

definition: To be unlike or distinct from something else; to disagree.
example: Their opinions on the matter differ significantly.

definition: The area of variation between upper and lower limits on a particular scale.
example: The hotel offers a wide range of services, from basic rooms to luxury suites.

definition: Causing someone to feel hurt, angry, or upset; rude or insulting.
example: His comments were highly offensive to many people in the audience.

definition: A distinct period or stage in a process of change or development.
example: The construction project is now in its final phase.

definition: Different from what is usual or expected; strange.
example: She found it odd that he didn't say goodbye before leaving.

definition: Easy to understand or do; not complicated.
example: The instructions for assembling the furniture were surprisingly straightforward.

definition: To get, acquire, or secure something.
example: You need a special permit to obtain access to the restricted area.

definition: To alter or move something slightly in order to achieve the desired fit, appearance, or result.
example: You may need to adjust your approach if the current method isn't working.

definition: In spite of that; however.
example: The weather was bad; nevertheless, we had a wonderful time.

definition: In a way that relates to a strategy or is important for achieving a goal.
example: The general positioned his troops strategically to gain an advantage.

definition: To differ in size, amount, degree, or nature from something else of the same general class.
example: The prices of flights can vary greatly depending on the season.

definition: To make a formal choice in an election or at a meeting.
example: Citizens have the right to vote for their chosen representatives.

definition: Feeling or showing a hopeless sense that a situation is so bad as to be impossible to deal with. Or needing or wanting something very much.
example: They were desperate for help after being stranded in the storm.

definition: To make something less confusing and more comprehensible.
example: Could you please clarify your instructions? I don't quite understand.

definition: To have a similar appearance to or qualities in common with someone or something.
example: The new building greatly resembles the historical architecture of the city.

definition: A part or element of a larger whole.
example: Hard work and dedication are essential components of success.

definition: Not mixed or adulterated with any other substance or material.
example: The water in the mountain stream was crystal pure.

definition: A movement of part of the body, especially a hand or the head, to express an idea or meaning.
example: He made a kind gesture by offering to help his neighbor.

definition: To make a serious, urgent, or heartfelt request.
example: The charity made an appeal for donations to help flood victims.

definition: To become aware or conscious of something; to come to realize or understand.
example: He began to perceive a change in her attitude over time.

definition: To put something into operation or effect; to use a rule, principle, or method.
example: We need to apply the lessons learned from this project to future endeavors.

definition: A person's state of mind regarding whether they are angry or calm.
example: He has a short temper, so it's easy for him to get angry.

definition: Connected with God or a god or dedicated to a religious purpose and so deserving veneration.
example: Many ancient cultures considered certain animals to be sacred.

definition: The quality or state of being closely connected or appropriate to what is being done or considered.
example: The relevance of his argument to the topic was clear to everyone.

definition: To diminish or destroy the value, quality, or enjoyment of something.
example: The bad weather threatened to spoil our outdoor picnic plans.

definition: To intensify, increase, or further improve the quality, value, or extent of something.
example: Good lighting can greatly enhance the atmosphere of a room.

definition: To give up something important or valued for the sake of other considerations.
example: Parents often make many sacrifices for their children's well-being.

definition: The speed at which someone or something moves, or with which something happens or is done.
example: The runner maintained a steady pace throughout the marathon.

definition: The relative size or extent of something.
example: The project was undertaken on a massive scale, involving thousands of workers.

definition: It is a pity or regrettable that something is the case.
example: Unfortunately, due to the rain, the outdoor concert was cancelled.

definition: The state of being male or female, typically used with reference to social and cultural differences rather than biological ones.
example: The company aims to achieve equality in terms of gender representation at all levels.

definition: For the purpose or benefit of someone or something.
example: For the sake of peace, they decided to compromise.

definition: The quality of being kind, understanding, and willing to give or share freely.
example: Her generosity allowed many students to receive scholarships.

definition: Showing gentleness, kindness, or affection.
example: He gave her a tender hug to show his support.
